title: How to file GSTR-1 yourself

sections.heading: Before you start
text: Tick the documents in the checklist on this page, and keep your login details ready. File any earlier GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B that is still missing first: the portal files returns in order.

sections.heading: Steps
steps: Log in to the GST portal and open **Services → Returns → Returns Dashboard**.
Choose the financial year and the period, then open **GSTR-1**.
Add your invoices: to registered businesses (B2B, with their GSTIN), to consumers (B2C), exports, and credit or debit notes. You can type them in or upload them with the offline tool.
Fill in the **HSN/SAC summary** and the **documents issued** section.
Click **Generate GSTR-1 summary**, check the preview carefully, then **File** with DSC or EVC (OTP).
Download the acknowledgement with the **ARN** (acknowledgement reference number).
text_after: If you had no sales at all in the period, a **nil GSTR-1** may be possible: see the official FAQ on nil filing.

sections.heading: After filing
text: Click **Mark as filed** on this page and upload the acknowledgement (PDF or photo), so you and your CA can always find it. The app reads the acknowledgement on our server and marks the filing "Filed–verified" when it matches.

sections.heading: Common mistakes
points: Wrong GSTIN of a customer, so their credit goes missing.
Reporting an invoice in the wrong period.
Forgetting credit notes for returned goods.
